title: Seal and open sync records
responsibility: Seal JSON values as v1 records with per-object HKDF keys and AES-256-GCM over an authenticated header, read that header, and open records for matching scope keys.

inputs.name: recordHeaderBytes.header
inputs.description: Scope, epoch, object identifier, and revision to encode in the record header.

inputs.name: sealedRecordHeader.envelope
inputs.description: Encoded record from which to read the versioned header.

inputs.name: sealedRecord.keys
inputs.description: Scope keys to derive the encryption key for this object.

inputs.name: sealedRecord.header
inputs.description: Object and revision metadata to authenticate with the encrypted record.

inputs.name: openSealedRecord.keys
inputs.description: Scope keys expected to match the record's header.

inputs.name: openSealedRecord.envelope
inputs.description: Encoded record to authenticate, decrypt, and decode.

outputs.name: recordHeaderBytes
outputs.description: Versioned header bytes used as authenticated data.

outputs.name: sealedRecordHeader
outputs.description: Parsed record header. Opening the record authenticates its header.

outputs.name: sealedRecord
outputs.description: Record envelope containing the header, nonce, and authenticated ciphertext.

outputs.name: openSealedRecord
outputs.description: Authenticated header and decoded JSON value.

errors.name: SealedError
errors.description: The header or revision is invalid, the scope does not match, or authentication fails.
